content: प्लु €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (प्लवते, प्लुत) .²1 To float, swim; किं नामैतत् मज्जन्त्यलाबूनि ग्रावाणः प्लवन्त इति <ls>Mv. 1</ls>; क्लेशोत्तरं रागवशात् प्लवन्ते <ls>R. 16. 60</ls>; प्लवन्ते धर्मलघवो लोकेऽम्भसि यथा प्लवाः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 To cross in a boat. .²3 To swing to and fro, vibrate. .²4 To leap, jump, spring; यथामुखीनः सीतायाः पुप्लुवे बहु लोभयन् <ls>Bk. 5. 48</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 13</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 46</ls>. .²5 To plunge into, bathe. .²6 To fly or haste away. .²7 To blow (as the wind). .²8 To fade away, disappear. .²9 To soar, hover about. .²10 To skip. .²11 To be prolated or lengthened (as a vowel). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (प्लावयति-ते) .²1 To cause to swim or float. .²2 To remove, wash away. .²3 To bathe. .²4 To inundate, deluge, flood, submerge; यैः प्लावयिष्यन्ति समन्ततोऽमी <ls>Śi. 3. 74</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">7. 74</ls>. .²5 To cause to reel or fluctuate. .²6 To lengthen, prolate (a vowel). --{%With%} अभि .²1 to over-flow. .²2 to overwhelm, overcome.
